from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAsset(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial asset amount reported in one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name reported in this filing")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Security/corporate code if present")
    asset_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial asset, e.g., '交易性金融资产'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount; None if not reported or N/A")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Financial period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    position: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is beginning (期初) or ending (期末) balance")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_assets: list[FinancialAsset]
